lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, zhège tí wǒ bù dǒng.
lines.en: Teacher, I don't understand this question.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ dǒng le! Xièxie nín.
lines.en: I get it now, teacher! Thank you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 明天有考试，大家要准备一下。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, dàjiā yào zhǔnbèi yīxià.
lines.en: There is an exam tomorrow, everyone should get ready.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How many questions are on the exam?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Shí ge. Dōu zài zhè běn shū li.
lines.en: Ten. They are all in this book.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: If you have questions, ask me again.
